description: Make the warmup-phase stage cheaper again, the next step after E047 (24 -> 20 px saved 3.5% at -0.18 pp). On the tip (E047, or I061's successor if it is kept, in which case change only its first stage), make one change: the first stage's resolution drops from 20 px to 16 px (F.interpolate, antialias=True, inside the compiled GPU augment after flip/translate/jitter). The stage boundary (1.5 epochs, in samples), total epochs, bs 1536 and every step-indexed schedule stay unchanged, so the sample stream and lr values are identical. In drafts/, first print the per-block spatial sizes at 16 px input. Expected: whitening 15, block1 15 -> pool 7, block2 7 -> pool 3, block3 3 -> pool 1, final map 1x1. The 16 px graph's final pool can then be a reshape/flatten of the 1x1 map, or F.max_pool2d with a static kernel equal to the final map size. Do NOT use amax or flatten().max (E009 Inductor bug). In build(), warm up the 16 px train step with and without whitening-bias grad at bs 1536, plus every partial-batch shape at the 1.5-epoch switch, using channels_last tensors in the exact timed layout (E035 lesson). Check that total build time stays under ~450 s. Run debug_nan.py on the new graphs under max-autotune-no-cudagraphs, and compare trial-0 with later-trial train times. Eval stays the 32 px graph.
